summary.business_type: Local service-area party bus and limousine operator
top_findings: Custom domain and V2 root cutover are incomplete
Business identity facts conflict across several sources
Regional DC, Maryland, and Northern Virginia hub pages are missing
Image dimensions and responsive delivery need improvement
Off-site local authority and verified reviews remain limited
quick_wins: Link the orphan FAQ and gallery pages
Standardize NAP, gratuity, hours, and price range
Replace generic social source links with Instagram only
Consolidate overlapping Tysons and McLean pages
Add image dimensions and true-LCP priority hints

findings.title: Launch routing mismatch
findings.description: V2 is under /v2 while canonical assets target future root-domain URLs.
findings.recommendation: Serve V2 at root and redirect /v2 equivalents before sitemap submission.

findings.title: Authority evidence
findings.description: Some claims and testimonials lack visible source proof.
findings.recommendation: Add verified review sources, author credentials, and primary citations.

findings.title: Regional hub gap
findings.description: No dedicated DC, Maryland, or Northern Virginia regional commercial hubs.
findings.recommendation: Create three authoritative regional landing pages.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Broad Service, FAQ, BlogPosting, WebSite and LocalBusiness coverage

findings.title: Fact consistency
findings.description: Email, price range, address, hours, gratuity, and review claims are not fully consistent.
findings.recommendation: Standardize and verify all visible and structured facts.

findings.title: Unverified field performance
findings.description: No final-domain CrUX data; 87 images lack intrinsic dimensions and no responsive sources are used.
findings.recommendation: Measure the final domain and implement width/height, srcset/sizes, and LCP prioritization.

findings.title: Entity authority
findings.description: Conflicting facts and a competing same-name entity weaken machine confidence.
findings.recommendation: Unify NAP/entity data and build corroborating third-party citations.

findings.title: Responsive image delivery
findings.description: 87 images lack width/height and no img uses srcset/sizes.
findings.recommendation: Add intrinsic dimensions and responsive WebP/AVIF variants.
